display.summary: The Updates card keeps itself current: the application image has its own check icon, the card re-reads its state in the background and after every check, and the Backup row icon highlights on hover.
highlights: The application image row has its own check icon, so the image can be re-checked even while a DjangoLux update is pending.
The Updates card refreshes in the background and shortly after a check, so a newly published image appears without a reload.
The Backup row icon highlights on hover like the others.
